$comment: The pinned catalogue for Linear (ADR 0009). Only the operations the connector slice uses, plus one write. A connect compares the upstream's tools/list with this pin: every operation here must be listed upstream with exactly these argument names and these required ones, or the connect is refused with connector_drift. The upstream may list more; the agent never sees an operation that is not here. Re-pin against the live catalogue (and re-read its argument names) before connecting a real workspace.
